components.name: wind_speed_boom1
components.rationale: Fixed reference range 0-30 m/s (design constant, not computed from the data). Values above are clipped to 1.

components.name: wind_speed_boom2
components.rationale: Same fixed reference range as boom 1.

components.name: air_temperature
components.rationale: Fixed reference range 150-300 K (design constant, not computed from the data). Inverted: colder air -> higher component value, because the EVA weather limits treat low temperature as the hazard (GO needs air and ground temperature above a minimum).
